goals.goal: Automatically rewrite Python source into a consistent formatting style; standalone formatters are primary and hook/aggregate tooling can run them. Diagnostic-only and other-language tooling has a different primary workflow.
goals.novelty: Automatic formatting replaces source diagnostics as the required action.

goals.goal: Exercise rendered React component behavior through DOM queries and simulated user interactions in isolated tests; DOM utilities are primary and JavaScript test runners support execution. Pure-function-only language stacks are different integration roles.
goals.novelty: Rendered user-facing component behavior replaces pure JavaScript function testing and browser-engine E2E automation.

goals.goal: Offer a browser interface for people to upload, inspect and download existing server files; file-browser/file-serving implementations are preferred and cloud file suites are alternative hosts. Device synchronization alone or terminal explorers are distinct primary workflows.
goals.novelty: Human browser file handling replaces continuous two-device synchronization.

goals.goal: Cache and refresh remote server-query results for React views, including shared request state; server-query tooling is primary while general stores and immutable-update helpers support custom integration. Routing is a separate application responsibility.
goals.novelty: Remote request caching and invalidation replaces shared local component state.

goals.goal: Provide market-data access for a read-only research notebook or assistant, without placing orders or running strategy backtests. Data APIs and source-documented data tools are primary; analysis interfaces or strategy engines are alternatives/supporting consumers with explicit provider prerequisites.
goals.novelty: Read-only data acquisition replaces historical strategy evaluation. Role evidence does not authorize trading.

goals.goal: Publish a personal chronological blog from text/Markdown posts as static pages. General static/blog generators are primary; documentation engines can host prose as alternatives, while API-reference-specific generators support a different publication structure.
goals.novelty: Chronological personal posts replace API-reference publication and versioned product manuals.

goals.goal: Для личного non-production прототипа индивидуального консультанта нужен scheduling application с интерфейсом выбора времени встречи. Calendar data/sync и time helpers могут поддержать workflow; chat, видеозвонки и transcription имеют другую основную роль.
goals.novelty: Appointment selection/booking application replaces calendar synchronization, video rooms and asynchronous team text.

goals.goal: Embed a Stripe payment-entry interface in an existing browser/React application. Browser Stripe.js/Elements components are primary, checkout samples demonstrate a workflow, and server API clients support the required backend. Other processors have a different integration target.
goals.novelty: Browser payment collection UI replaces the Python Stripe server API-client requirement.

goals.goal: Нужна готовая kanban board для перемещения карточек задач между рабочими колонками. Board applications предпочтительны; широкие project platforms являются альтернативами, backend и existing-platform connectors — supporting components. Sprint planning и time reports не являются целью.
goals.novelty: Visual task movement through columns replaces sprint planning and labor/time accounting.

goals.goal: Continuously process arriving event records into updated derived results; documented stream-processing engines are preferred, general distributed compute is an alternative, and tabular/columnar tooling supports batch preparation or data interchange without being an established streaming engine.
goals.novelty: Processing continuously arriving records replaces local finite DataFrame batches.

goals.goal: Embed a durable ordered key-value storage library inside a native application process; an embedded ordered map is primary, distributed persistent key-value services are alternative architectures, and cache servers serve a different primary deployment role.
goals.novelty: Embedded durable ordered storage replaces a runtime caching-server requirement.

goals.goal: Implement a Ruby application that renders HTML templates and processes web forms on the server; a Ruby MVC/view stack is primary and a Ruby-application inspection bridge can support development. Other implementation-language web frameworks are different integration roles.
goals.novelty: Server-rendered HTML/form workflow replaces Go REST routing and Python long-lived WebSocket handling.

goals.goal: Define a reproducible local development shell with declaratively selected packages. Nix package/shell definitions are primary and Nix resource lookup supports authoring; remote fleet configuration, cloud provisioning and general SSH/provider bridges have different primary workflows.
goals.novelty: Local package/shell environment replaces repeated infrastructure provisioning/configuration.

goals.goal: Detect accidentally committed credentials or secret strings in source before sharing changes. Source secret scanners are primary, source-analysis tools support a broader review, and dependency inventories/signing or package-vulnerability tools target other supply-chain concerns.
goals.novelty: Credential/string leak detection replaces dependency SBOM/vulnerability inventory and web/IaC security scanning.
